changelog:
- Expanded support for more languages and project types: now recognizes Go and Rust in addition to Node, Python, and Docker.
- Improved detection logic: a repository can match multiple project types, choosing the canonical workflow based on documentation.
- More detailed dependency installation instructions per language, including virtual environments for Python and tool-specific commands.
- Docker instructions now prefer documented docker-compose paths when present.
- Maintains strong safety and confirmation safeguards throughout the workflow.
